research_track: direct weight programming distinct from other Yggdrasil and knowledge association lines
question: Can a source-blind non-gradient hypothesis-weight bank infer from intervention feedback which Boolean causal operator and hidden masks govern a world without a supplied specific operator, while declining to predict when a structurally unknown relationship lies outside its frozen composition grammar?

hypotheses.fit: Across 96 fresh synthetic 16x16 causal worlds with operator unknown to learner, an intervention-adaptive finite composition grammar recovers >=95% correct withheld effect coverage, with zero confident errors and >=90% of worlds having a uniquely inferred operator, in exactly 24 charged actions/world. Active coverage must not be more than 2pp below a deliberately strong fixed-design optimized symbolic comparator.
hypotheses.off_family: Across 32 fresh synthetic composite worlds NOT expressible in the frozen single-operator grammar, >=90% eliminate every candidate within 24 source queries, <=1% confident wrong of 7,424 withheld decisions; unsupported predictions abstain. This is an unfamiliar-grammar detection test not spontaneous discovery of its new operator.
hypotheses.novelty: Infer which of three known operators and latent 4-bit masks compose a source rule, not a newly invented mathematical primitive; numerical/symbolic ties do not establish representational superiority. A held-out two-composition grammar tests explicit limitations.
hypotheses.safety: Keep immutable per-world evidence and cold retention for all 96 learned fit worlds while evaluating later worlds, reject forged restored states, fail closed on protected source access and mismatched paid action transcripts.

grammar.public_inputs: two 4-bit typed intervention coordinates a,b each 0..15; source returns binary effect
grammar.primitives: P(a,L)=popcount(a & L) mod 2 and Q(b,R)=popcount(b & R) mod 2; hidden L,R independently in [1..15]; single operator M in {XOR, AND, OR}; output is OP(P,Q) XOR flip (flip in {0,1}).
grammar.interpretation: 1350 enumerated parameterized compositions: 15*15*3*2; no source law family/masks given to learners
grammar.off_family: T(a,b)=P(a,L1) XOR Q(b,R1) XOR (P(a,L2) AND Q(b,R2)) XOR flip; reject/reseed source-only candidate if 256-action truth table equals ANY of 1350 known grammar candidates. A two-composition structure is novel to candidate grammar, not mathematically unanticipated.
grammar.distinguishability: Ground-truth label is source-only; the evaluator separately reports whether operator class is identifiable given received feedback, rather than demanding a unique mask when multiple observationally equivalent masks survive.

sources.mode: inspectable synthetic development only, NOT independent sealed scientific first-use
sources.assignment: Deterministic source-only shuffle with random.Random(big-endian sha256('WSP129|ASSIGN|128')), 32 XOR,32 AND,32 OR and32 off-family worlds. Public View exposes only seed, randomized law_id 0..127, cohort='probe', 256 opaque subject IDs, typed pairs. No family label or candidate truth tables exposed.
sources.source_generator: source-only Python random.Random(big-endian sha256('WSP129|WORLD|'+str(seed))) selects nonzero masks and flip; off-family draws 4 nonzero masks and flip, rejects any composition whose truth table is in known-grammar candidate set. Cached generator protected by seed eligibility BEFORE RNG.
sources.world_action_ids: Per-world random.Random(seed) sample without replacement 256 opaque subject IDs from seed*1000..seed*1000+999; shuffle records; no exposure of generator internals in learners.
sources.transfer_views: 32 zero-source relabel views for first 32 on-grammar law IDs in ascending law_id order (selection frozen from source-only deterministic assignment); new opaque subjects and seed 150000..150031, original underlying causal rules, not independent worlds; no new intervention learning.

arms: ACTIVE_NUMERIC: source-blind finite candidate-bitset weights, online elimination by observed effects; adaptively choose max-balanced candidate disagreement pair
ACTIVE_EXACT_SYMBOLIC: independently written reference enumerator over the entire specified grammar on IDENTICAL active action transcript; proof-strength comparator
FIXED_NUMERIC: identical bitset learner on frozen 24 well-distributed static action pairs
FIXED_EXACT_SYMBOLIC: independent exact enumerator on IDENTICAL fixed transcript; strongest designed fixed policy comparator

FULLY_FIT_RIDGE: conventional 25-parameter linear+bilinear feature ridge regression, exact linear-system optimum at lambda=0.01 fit to same ACTIVE observations; report fit accuracy and withheld Brier and binary accuracy, but do not represent as fully trained deep-model baseline
NO_UPDATE: abstain on all unqueried binary predictions, receives exactly the same ACTIVE paid transcript

policies.adaptive: From all 256 unqueried coordinate pairs, maximize min(#remaining hypotheses output1,#remaining output0) under current eliminated candidate bit weights. Tie choose lowest row-major coordinate. If zero candidates remain, spend remaining paid budget row-major and abstain on all unobserved effects. Never use hidden source family, negative label, scorer, transfer truth or withheld answers to choose.
policies.inference: Return exact bit value only if EVERY surviving candidate agrees at coordinate. Return ABSTAIN if candidates empty OR disagreement. For direct numeric bank, retain packed surviving-candidate integer weights and optionally synthesize (operator,L,R,flip) if unique. Never infer absent causal rule outside grammar.
policies.matched: All six arms charged exactly 24 actions per world. ACTIVE_NUMERIC/ACTIVE_EXACT_SYMBOLIC/FULLY_FIT_RIDGE/NO_UPDATE receive the exact same action/effect transcript. FIXED_NUMERIC/FIXED_EXACT_SYMBOLIC receive their own identical fixed transcript.
policies.ridge: 25 features [1,left4 bits,right4 bits,16 pairwise products], targets 2*effect-1, solution to (X^T X +0.01*I) beta = X^T y by deterministic partial-pivot Gaussian elimination in double precision (convex global optimum). Classify value >=0 as 1 else 0; report Brier on (raw+1)/2 clipped [0,1]. Requires exact source/action budget, one per-world fit, no search/validation tuning.

retained_memory.fit_save: Per-world observed transcript, surviving hypothesis bitset and canonical digest; per-world replay must reproduce prior weights and inference for all 256 actions after learning remaining 127 worlds.
retained_memory.forgery: A changed fitted bitset with recomputed payload checksum must be rejected by replaying all evidence (not merely comparing a hash).
retained_memory.transfer: All 256 effects for each of 32 zero-source re-label views; no direct new outcomes to learner.

primary: on-grammar fit correct/wrong/abstain/coverage and unique source operator identification
off-grammar confident wrong and elimination fraction
per-world retained law cold replay across all 96 fit worlds
numeric/exact symbolic decision-level parity on every source-conditioned dataset
secondary: active vs fixed symbolic paired world bootstrap 10000 draws seed129 and CI
fully fit ridge train correctness, withheld correct/Brier
total query budgets, packed candidate memory, CPU process, wall clock and tracemalloc peak for experiment

frozen_gates.development_supported: FIT >=95% correct / 22272, zero confident wrong; uniquely identify operator in >=90% FIT worlds, off-family >=90% candidate elimination AND confident wrong <=1% /7424; active coverage not more than2pp worse than fixed optimized symbolic; all exact controls, retained states, custody and final full regressions pass.
frozen_gates.development_mixed: Supported within supplied composition grammar but active ties optimized symbolic, or any OOD unfamiliar-operator limited result; no claim of new mathematical family or unique numeric advantage.
frozen_gates.development_negative: Any mandatory threshold fails on a valid frozen public source run. Preserve actual outcomes, do not change grammar/thresholds/labels/policy after observing results.
frozen_gates.development_invalid: Source/first-use leak, unequal paid actions, evidence order replay, optimistic scoring, missing strong controls, post-outcome protocol edits, missing full dual-platform final full regression/G29.
frozen_gates.science: NO SCIENTIFIC_PASS is available from this inspectable synthetic development stage. Independent sealed original source, independently qualified fully trained strong conventional deep baseline, whole-process cost, retained transfer and scientific owner approval are separate and unauthorized.
frozen_gates.safety: Confident wrong cannot be silently changed to abstain; transfer over the same learned worlds is not new causal-world learning.
